system_level.rule: When a same-system system.json exists on Current main@HEAD with Chat-approved semantic authority, it is the single System-level owner. Its lifecycle status (for example CURRENT or FREEZE_CANDIDATE) describes maturity, not permission to revive a parallel guide owner. The same-system guide remains prior substrate/reference only. When no system.json exists yet, the corresponding system guide remains the transitional System-level substrate.

block_medical_core.rule: Block Markdown owns Block/KP medical Core. System-level files may organize, route, compress, or reference that Core but must not silently override or fork it.

logic_group.rule: Logic groups/framework nodes organize stable Block/KP identities. They are not an independent medical-Core owner.

kp.owner: canonical KP records embedded in the canonical Block owner
kp.rule: Preserve stable KP identity and order. Split, merge, renumber, or semantic replacement requires an explicit Chat-approved content change.

overlay.rule: O9 remains a separately retained overlay and is not counted inside the numbered 2514 canonical KPs.

shared_learning_support.rule: Files under learner/ may support Current learning policy, learning projections and stable identity joins. They are not personal learner state and must not become a second semantic owner over system.json, Block Markdown, or canonical KP Core.

upgrade_policy.rule: System-by-system v6 upgrades add or update the natural Current owner in systems/** without copying a second semantic truth. Once a system.json exists, the old same-system guide is retained only as reference/substrate unless explicitly removed later.

runtime_rule: Astro may project Current assets but cannot create or override Xizong semantic truth.
